lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I need a copy of my birth certificate.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Standard processing is the usual. It goes through the ledger, then the archive. Takes three days.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Fee is 150 денари. You come back during office hours and pick it up.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: If you can’t wait, there’s an expedited route. It’s… prioritized.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: That one is 500 денари. Ready tomorrow. Pickups after 13:00.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She leans back a little. Her gaze drifts past you, toward the corridor.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: No queue, no stamps. You come after 16:00 and it’s done.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her voice softens, just enough not to carry.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: If you choose that last one, don’t wait in line. Just come to the counter. Quietly.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She taps the counter once, then slides a form across to you.
